SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY
COALESCE(SUM(a.profit_amount), 0) DESC,
COALESCE(SUM(a.return_rate), 0) DESC,
m.member_id ASC ) AS rankPosition,
m.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname AS nickname, m.profile AS profile,
CASE WHEN #{includePrivateDetails} = TRUE OR COALESCE(s.is_stock_public, FALSE) = TRUE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS tradeHistoryPublicYn,
COALESCE(SUM(a.return_rate), 0) AS returnRate, COALESCE(SUM(a.holding_stock_quantity), 0) AS holdingQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(a.profit_amount), 0) AS profit
FROM member m
LEFT JOIN settings s ON s.member_id = m.member_id
LEFT JOIN account_link al ON al.member_id = m.member_id
LEFT JOIN account a ON a.account_id = al.account_id
WHERE m.member_role = 'USER'
AND COALESCE(s.is_stock_public, FALSE) = TRUE
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.nickname, m.profile, s.is_stock_public
ORDER BY rankPosition ASC

SELECT ranked.rank_position FROM ( SELECT m.member_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(a.return_rate), 0) DESC, m.member_id ASC ) AS rank_position FROM member m LEFT JOIN settings s ON s.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN account_link al ON al.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN account a ON a.account_id = al.account_id WHERE m.member_role = 'USER' AND COALESCE(s.is_stock_public, FALSE) = TRUE GROUP BY m.member_id ) ranked WHERE ranked.member_id = #{memberId} AND ranked.rank_position <= 3

SELECT ranked.rank_position FROM ( SELECT m.member_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY
COALESCE(SUM(a.profit_amount), 0) DESC,
COALESCE(SUM(a.return_rate), 0) DESC,
m.member_id ASC ) AS rank_position FROM member m LEFT JOIN settings s ON s.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN account_link al ON al.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN account a ON a.account_id = al.account_id WHERE m.member_role = 'USER' AND COALESCE(s.is_stock_public, FALSE) = TRUE GROUP BY m.member_id ) ranked WHERE ranked.member_id = #{memberId} AND ranked.rank_position <= 3
